entries.title: Combining Kangaroo Mother Care and Oral Rehydration Salts plus Zinc
entries.headline: Implement kangaroo mother care at birth and provide oral rehydration salts plus zinc as the standard first treatment for small babies to reduce newborn deaths and improve health outcomes.
entries.mechanism: Kangaroo mother care provides skin-to-skin contact and promotes breastfeeding, while oral rehydration salts plus zinc treat dehydration and diarrhea, reducing the risk of newborn deaths.

entries.title: Combining Insecticide-Treated Bed Nets and Teaching at the Right Level
entries.headline: Distribute insecticide-treated bed nets and implement teaching at the right level to improve health and education outcomes for children.
entries.problem: Children dying before age five and not finishing primary school
entries.mechanism: Insecticide-treated bed nets prevent malaria, while teaching at the right level improves education outcomes, reducing the risk of children dying before age five and not finishing primary school.
